title: Leo client configuration
description: Canonical schema for Leo editor client settings. Each client maps these onto its native config surface; see config-schema.md for the per-client table.

leo.languageServer.path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the leo-lsp executable. A leading ~/ is expanded to the user's home directory. When empty, the client falls back to the canonical 5-tier discovery order.

leo.languageServer.args.description: Additional arguments appended verbatim to the leo-lsp command line.
